name: music_native_flow
description: Music from one prompt line: MiniMax Music 3 through the music card — prompt in, audio out. WHAT it produces: the generated audio artifact. HOW it runs: the single music card stage composes through the card plane, so the {flow:} door submits ONE merged run (validate then start); the compose_music POST tool runs the same row in one call; the {model:} door or the bench drives the music card directly. Knobs: prompt (required) — what to play; duration (optional, default 120) — seconds of music, 5..360, overlaid onto the stage.

duration.description: Optional. Seconds of music (default 120, the card caps 5..360).
